title: Gintama': Futon ni Haitte kara Buki Nokoshi ni Kizuite Neru ni Nerenai Toki mo Aru
native: 銀魂 〜布団に入ってから拭き残しに気付いて寝るに寝れない時もある〜
synopsis:
A special episode that was previewed at a screening at Jump Special Anime Festa 2014. 
The tagline for the anime reads, "It's time for all the Yorozuya members ...to wake up just one more time."

Note: On April 3, 2015, it was bundled with a limited edition of the manga's 58th volume.
